headline: 73% of BLEND-v1's residual variance is real hashrate movement during the un-observed remainder of the epoch. That variable is absent from our data. No model architecture can recover it.

missing_variables.variable: Fleet deployment schedule (EH/s coming online, by week)
missing_variables.expected_information_content: HIGH - directly is the hashrate drift term
missing_variables.public_proxy: Public miners' monthly operational updates (hashrate deployed + guidance), published within days of month-end; covers ~25-30% of network
missing_variables.reconstruction: Buildable as a text timeline from archived releases; ~36 monthly observations

conclusion: Priority order per directive section 10 is respected: this is a NEW-INFORMATION problem first, a representation problem second, and NOT a model-complexity problem. Adding a bigger model to the existing inputs cannot cross 1.541pp and is very unlikely to beat 2.955pp by much.
honest_ceiling_with_current_data: Estimated 2.6-2.8pp MAE at k=500 (capture ~40-45%) if S3+S4 both work. Reaching the 50% target (2.25pp) almost certainly requires S2 deployment data.
